provenance.use_limit: Preparation only. No real prospect records or source-post bodies are supplied.

founder_questions.question: What business or communication decision would you like this work to support?
Who is the intended buyer, in what situation, and what would they use or do instead?
Describe one actual product decision: goal, constraint, plausible alternatives, choice and reason at the time.
What happened afterward, and which parts are observation versus your present interpretation?
What current capability, example or outcome can we verify, and which details must remain private?
Who would confirm product facts and approve voice, claims, visuals and final wording?
What time, budget, approval or access limits should the proposed scope respect?
Is a next step actually useful? If so, what did we agree and who owns it?

mini_audit.confidence_limit: A source-bounded clarity review is not an audit of all posts, account access, buyer demand, legal compliance or commercial performance.

scope_and_price_decisions: Pending founder agreement; this kit does not decide Plan1/Plan2, discounts, guarantees or access terms.
